```json
 "topology": "StrongARM latch with PMOS reset switches and output inverters",
 "rationale": "A StrongARM latch draws no static current, so energy is just CV^2. The budget is 100 fJ, about 31 fF switched at 1.8 V. The 10 fF output takes about 32 fJ, which leaves roughly 15 fF for internal nodes. That forces minimum-L devices with small widths. Latch tau is about C/gm, near 12 ps. With ln(0.9 V/(Av*1 mV)) of about 6, regeneration takes about 75 ps. Adding integration and inverter delay gives under 150 ps."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "W_in":   (2.0, 0.8, 6.0),    # input pair width (um), L=0.15
    "W_tail": (2.0, 0.8, 6.0),    # clocked tail nfet
    "W_ln":   (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),   # latch nfet
    "W_lp":   (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),   # latch pfet
    "W_rst":  (0.5, 0.42, 1.5),   # reset pfets
    "W_ninv": (0.8, 0.42, 3.0),   # output inverter nfet
    "r_inv":  (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),    # inverter Wp/Wn
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    L = 0.15
    VDD = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    dv = spec.get("dv", 1e-3)
    Wi, Wt, Wln, Wlp, Wr = p["W_in"], p["W_tail"], p["W_ln"], p["W_lp"], p["W_rst"]
    Wni = p["W_ninv"]; Wpi = Wni * p["r_inv"]

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")
    # tail switch
    n.M("MT", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wt, L)
    # input pair
    n.M("M1", "dip", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", Wi, L)
    n.M("M2", "din", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", Wi, L)
    # cross-coupled latch
    n.M("M3", "xp", "xn", "dip", "vss", "nfet", Wln, L)
    n.M("M4", "xn", "xp", "din", "vss", "nfet", Wln, L)
    n.M("M5", "xp", "xn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wlp, L)
    n.M("M6", "xn", "xp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wlp, L)
    # reset switches (clk low -> precharge to VDD)
    n.M("MR1", "xp", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("MR2", "xn", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("MR3", "dip", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("MR4", "din", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    # output inverters: vinp>vinn -> xp falls first -> outp high
    n.M("MI1", "outp", "xp", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wni, L)
    n.M("MI2", "outp", "xp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wpi, L)
    n.M("MI3", "outn", "xn", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wni, L)
    n.M("MI4", "outn", "xn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wpi, L)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    on = lut.op("n", Wln, L, 0.9, 0.9)
    op_ = lut.op("p", Wlp, L, 0.9, 0.9)
    oi = lut.op("n", Wi, L, 0.9, 0.6)
    ini = lut.op("n", Wni, L, 0.9, 0.9)
    inp = lut.op("p", Wpi, L, 0.9, 0.9)
    gm_latch = on["gm"] + op_["gm"]
    # node capacitance at xp: latch gates + drains (~0.6 x gate cap) + inverter + reset drain
    c_x = 1.6 * (on["cgg"] + op_["cgg"]) + ini["cgg"] + inp["cgg"] \
          + 0.6 * lut.op("p", Wr, L, 0.0, 0.9)["cgg"]
    c_d = 0.6 * (oi["cgg"] + on["cgg"]) + 0.6 * lut.op("p", Wr, L, 0.0, 0.9)["cgg"]
    tau = c_x / max(gm_latch, 1e-9)
    # integration phase: tail current discharges dip/din and then xp/xn to ~VDD-Vthn
    itail = max(lut.op("n", Wt, L, 1.8, 0.3)["Id"], 1e-6)
    t_int = (c_d * 0.9 + c_x * 0.7) * 2 / itail
    av = max(oi["gm"] * 0.7 / max(itail, 1e-9) * 2, 1.0)  # ~ (gm/Id)*Vthn gain
    t_regen = tau * math.log(0.9 / max(av * dv, 1e-6))
    ipinv = max(lut.op("p", Wpi, L, 1.8, 0.9)["Id"], 1e-6)
    t_inv = (cl + 2 * ini["cgg"]) * 0.9 / ipinv
    delay = t_int + t_regen + t_inv

    c_sw = 2 * c_d + 1.5 * c_x + cl + inp["cgg"] + ini["cgg"]
    energy = c_sw * VDD**2 * 1.1
    return n, {"correct": 1, "delay": delay, "energy": energy}
```
